objective.name: status
objective.description: Tell what the gateway knows of a call_id: whether it was reserved, its state, and its result when it is terminal.

#root.role: Read the gateway journal for one call_id and return its attempt identity, state, transmission and, for a terminal state, the bounded result.

transformation_contract.morphing: A call_id becomes the gateway's authoritative account of that call.
invariants: Read only: status never reserves, sends or changes an attempt.
known false means the gateway holds no reservation for the call_id: a call that may be attempted under the current policy.

A state reserved or transmitting found at startup has already been reconciled: reserved without transmitting becomes failed_before_transmission, transmitting becomes outcome_unknown. status never reports a possibly transmitted call as unsent.
success: The payload says known, and when known the attempt_id, state, reason, transmission and, for a terminal state, the bounded result.
notes: Agentic uses status after a lost connection or a restart, and to find attempts of which its journal has no record (orphan effects).
